Method of Attack: Exploitation of a critical .NET deserialization vulnerability in the Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX component to gain remote code execution
Deployment of malicious payloads in the C:\Windows\Temp\ folder to collect and exfiltrate information
Malware capable of deploying additional payloads, evading detection by deleting traces, opening reverse shells for persistence
Dropping an ASPX web shell for browsing local system, file upload/download, and remote command execution (though not observed in this case)
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS) web server
Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX component
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unpatched Telerik UI ASP.NET AJAX vulnerability on Microsoft IIS server
Indicators of Compromise: Indicators of compromise (IOCs) found on the unnamed federal civilian executive branch (FCEB) agency's network
Malicious payloads deployed in C:\Windows\Temp\ folder
No webshells dropped due to restrictive service account permissions
